entries.note: First step of the tracker's progress bar: the retailer has released the order to BJS. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Order status value: the page says the order is on its way to BJS from the retailer, or that BJS will propose a delivery date soon. Read from the live tracker's script; no lookup showed it.
Second step of the progress bar: BJS has received the goods. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Third step of the progress bar: a delivery date is booked. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Fourth step of the progress bar: the delivery slot is confirmed. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Fifth step of the progress bar: the crew is on the way. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Last step of the progress bar, and the status the mini tracker's lookup returned for a delivered order.
Order status value that ends tracking for a finished order. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Order status value for a failed attempt; the status bar then says the delivery was attempted on a date. Read from the live tracker's script; no archived lookup shows a history.
Order status value: the page says the order is on hold pending the retailer's instructions. Read from the live tracker's script; no lookup showed it.
Order status value: the page says the order has been cancelled. Read from the live tracker's script; no lookup showed it.
